source='''def transform(grid):\n    """Translate the full pattern down by one row; fill the exposed row with background."""\n    if not grid:\n        return []\n    from collections import Counter\n    flat = [v for row in grid for v in row]\n    background = Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    return [[background] * len(grid[0])] + [list(row) for row in grid[:-1]]\n'''
